summary: Keep Forkable settings in config.toml, preflight old settings before auth writes, and scrub only app-owned legacy credential locations.
reason: Malformed coexisting JSON must fail before credentials change; explicit settings paths may share a folder with unrelated files, while app-managed relocated homes need their own legacy JSON scrubbed and reported honestly.
validated_outcome: The full Forkable test, vet, and build suites pass, including failed preflight preserving auth state and doctor ignoring unrelated sibling JSON.
